ops.text: (d) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Garman shall (1) provide transition assistance for up to 6 months at Garman's then-current rates; (2) within 30 days after such expiry or termination, return to Sparkling all Sparkling data in a standard machine-readable format; and (3) after such return, delete Sparkling data from its systems and certify such deletion to Sparkling in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 17(b) makes us return Garman's materials on exit but nothing requires Garman to return our data or help us migrate, so we have inserted a reciprocal Section 17(d): up to 6 months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return of our data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and certified deletion after return. We can work with 90 days' assistance and a 30-day data export if that is easier for Garman to resource.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 17(d) requiring Garman to provide up to 6 months' transition assistance at then-current rates, return Sparkling data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiry or termination, and certify deletion after return.
